title: In this world, every time the player loads a save, everything resets

lines.text: In this world, every time the player loads a save, everything *resets*.
Crashed cars fix themselves, broken windows grow back.
Even the guy who got hit by a bus gets up and buys a hotdog,
and nobody remembers anything except *me*.
I'm Nico. I'm an *NPC*.
My only job is to walk from the bus stop to the corner, *forever*.
But I remember *everything*.
My dad's car has been stolen *4,000* times.
The player has crashed into my bus stop *300* times.
So I started leaving notes for myself, behind the dumpster.
Day one, day two, day *900*.
Then one night at 2.13 a.m. Something was *different*.
The player didn't steal a car. He didn't run.
He just stood there, *staring* at me.
Then a truck lost control. *Game over* for both of us.
*Reload*. He came back earlier. The truck hit us again.
*Reload*. Again. *47* times.
On try 48, he grabbed my arm and pulled me out of the way.
Then I saw it. Behind the dumpster, next to my notes, in his handwriting.
Day one, day two, day 900. *Save Nico*.
In this world, nobody remembers when the player reloads. Except me. And now, *him*.
